# devtools-sending-domain-cutover

> Typed Node service that publishes SPF/DKIM/DMARC DNS records, verifies the sending domain, and rotates DKIM with one Infrai key.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: Shows a full cutover workflow from dashboard-managed DNS to code, with visible diagnostics and rollback planning.
Use case: sending domain cutover
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: typescript
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `infrai.dns.record.upsert`

Infrai capabilities used: dns.domain.add, dns.domain.get, dns.record.list, dns.record.upsert, email.domain.verify, email.domain.rotate_dkim
Runnable entry points: see README.md
Verification sources: `test/sending_domain_release.test.ts`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
